This April, OpenAI launched the upgraded image generation technology ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company released an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

ChatGPT Images 2 was a significant leap forward compared to the company's earlier image generation tools.

It added 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to use web searches to obtain the latest information. Images 2 also improved handling of non-Latin scripts and offered two intelligence tiers: Instant and Thinking.

The latest Images 2.5 version focuses on "sharper details, faster generation speed, more precise editing, and improved creation and sharing tools."

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 delivers more natural lighting and richer textures, performs better at preserving subjects from reference images, and more reliably follows editing instructions across multiple conversation turns."

"We have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0, allowing you to generate images and refine your ideas more quickly."

In addition, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature that allows users to draw directly within ChatGPT and use the drawings as references for image generation. OpenAI also simultaneously launched templates for popular image formats and a prompt-sharing feature that lets others try out image generation-related ideas.

Furthermore, OpenAI is launching two versions of Images 2.5 for developers to build applications within their apps. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be available through OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same improvements in quality, editing, and speed to the API, serving as the default choice for most applications, delivering higher-quality images at 50% lower latency than GPT‑Image‑2. It is suitable for creators and social media content, product experiences, visual search, rapid image prototyping, and high-volume generation scenarios. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for high-end visual workflows requiring finer editing control, suitable for production workflows such as creating ready-to-launch promotional materials or refined product images.

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 will roll out starting today to all tiers of ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users, covering desktop, mobile, and web versions." You can click here to learn more about this new image generation technology.

Today's launch of ChatGPT Images 2.5 follows last week's release of GPT-6 Astra.
